base_url: http://127.0.0.1:4320 (direct) or same-origin /api/* through the Next.js web app (proxy)

conventions.authentication: Authorization: Bearer <RS256 access token> from POST /v1/auth/login or /v1/auth/refresh (local sign-in, ADR-021); external OIDC is configurable but not used yet
conventions.tenant_context: X-Organization-Id: <uuid> on every organization route; the API checks an ACTIVE membership in MySQL on every request and takes the role from it, never from the token
conventions.errors: every failure is {code, message, request_id} (contract Problem); codes are stable; X-Request-Id is returned on every response
conventions.idempotency: POST /v1/uploads, /v1/imports, /v1/players and player registration require an Idempotency-Key header (8-128 safe characters)
conventions.time: media times are integer microseconds since the video's first frame (pts_us); boxes are normalised 0..1 to the decoded frame (x, y = top-left)
conventions.identity: track_number is a temporary per-run reference; canonical_otsi_id appears only for REGISTERED/RETIRED players and only after a CONFIRMED human decision
